annotations.title: Romania B2B lead list: companies by CAEN, county, turnover, employees

description: $0.001 per returned company, min $0.05 per call (x402, USDC on Base, no account). Use when you need a list of Romanian companies matching criteria (sales prospecting, market sizing, supplier sourcing). Romanian B2B lead generation / prospect list (ONRC + ANAF): companies by CAEN code(s), county (judet), city, latest turnover, employees, net profit, founding year; sorted by turnover. Rows: CUI, name, legal form, address, CAEN, status, VAT flag, turnover/profit/employees. Public company data only, no personal emails/phones. The 402 shows 2 sample rows + match count.

ca_min.description: Minimum latest-year turnover (cifra de afaceri), RON.

caen.description: Main CAEN code(s), 4 digits, comma-separated (max 10), e.g. 4752,4673. At least one of caen or judet is required.

infiintata_din.description: Founded in or after this year (registration date).

infiintata_pana.description: Founded in or before this year.

judet.description: County (judet), diacritics optional, e.g. Brasov, Cluj, Bucuresti.

limit.description: Companies per page, 1-500 (default 100). Price = rows returned x per-company price, with a minimum per call.

localitate.description: City / locality, exact name as in ONRC, diacritics optional, e.g. Brasov.

offset.description: Skip this many matches (0-9500) for the next page.

profit_min.description: Minimum latest-year net profit, RON (0 = profitable only).

name: romania_company_leads

items.description: One lead: public company data only.

an_bilant.description: latest balance-sheet year available (null = no filing)

platitor_tva.description: ANAF VAT payer from the last cached ANAF check (null = not checked yet)

total_matches.description: matches for the filters (counted up to 10000; see total_capped)
